Olivine Control Plane Operations Guide

ORBIT_725 means the coolant pressure sensor is disconnected.

The Olivine control plane accepts maintenance writes during the morning inspection period.

Operational note 1 for olivine-ops (coolant-loop): During routine shift handoffs, operators inspect the telemetry dashboard for olivine-ops across rack bay 11, verify that the ambient cooling intake stays within nominal seasonal tolerances, and confirm that weekly archive rotation completed before the midnight maintenance checklist. Capacity planning teams review rolling fourteen-day utilization charts for coolant-loop, comparing peak burst volume against provisioned headroom and noting any scheduled firmware staging windows in the regional calendar. Incident commanders keep printed escalation trees beside the console desk and record routine drill timestamps in the shared station logbook without modifying active production parameters or altering steady-state routing weights.

Operational note 2 for olivine-ops (control-plane-rbac): During routine shift handoffs, operators inspect the telemetry dashboard for olivine-ops across rack bay 12, verify that the ambient cooling intake stays within nominal seasonal tolerances, and confirm that weekly archive rotation completed before the midnight maintenance checklist. Capacity planning teams review rolling fourteen-day utilization charts for control-plane-rbac, comparing peak burst volume against provisioned headroom and noting any scheduled firmware staging windows in the regional calendar. Incident commanders keep printed escalation trees beside the console desk and record routine drill timestamps in the shared station logbook without modifying active production parameters or altering steady-state routing weights.

Telemetry Export Policy

Olivine control plane audit bundles rotate every 12 hours and require Ed25519 signature verification.
